verdict.rationale: Reflect documents an OAuth2 (PKCE) REST API with write:graph scope. An agent can headlessly create notes (POST /graphs/{graphId}/notes) and append to daily notes (PUT daily-notes), but the read side is explicitly blocked: 'Our servers can't read the contents of your notes, so we can't serve them up in the API.' Reads are limited to graphs, bookmarked links and user info, so only the write half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: API read access to note contents, an official MCP server or local API, versioning/sandbox documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.
